expectations.text: Fits the recommended plan inside roughly 3 hours a month
expectations.evidence: The section 4 table budgets 60 + 45 + 45 + 15 + 15 minutes, which is exactly 180 minutes. The section 5 weekly schedule matches it (60 + 45 + 45 + 30 = 180), and replies are counted inside each week's slot. The only other item is a one-time 10-minute account check, marked 'once'. Section 9 gives a fallback that cuts the work to about 1 hour a month. Nothing in the plan pushes the recurring workload past 3 hours.

expectations.text: Fits the recommended plan inside roughly 3 hours a month
expectations.evidence: The section is titled 'The 180 minutes a month'. Its block budgets add up to exactly 180 minutes: 45+30+30+20+30+15+10. The transcript also says outright: 'Don't spend more than about 3 hours a month here.' It adds a rule to cut back to 60 minutes if there are no signups. One point off because the Cadence section muddles the monthly allocation. Block 1 runs 'once', but block 4's quarterly minutes get folded into it 'in other months'. Block 7 is missing from the monthly list. So the real total for a typical month is unclear, though it never goes over 3 hours.
